scope: Native complete-upload inspection and source-ready ownership
behavior: inspect full staged input without encoding
SourceReady retains input and metadata; repeated inspect returns readback
configure_source allowed only while SourceReady; preparation takes options with input under lock
Cancel during inspection retains admission until worker returns then discards input and metadata
Failed probe and SourceReady shutdown clean up staged input

scenarios: Real upload inspect duration0.25/24fps then configure brightness255 produces6 white frames
Partial input rejected; duplicate inspection does not rerun probe
Append/new admission/prepare rejected while owned by inspector
Blocked successful inspector cannot publish metadata after cancellation
Damaged input failure cleanup and SourceReady shutdown cleanup

limitations: Intermediate inspection not yet exposed via Tauri commands/UI
